company.shortDescription: Beyond Meat is a food processing company that specializes in providing plant-based meat.
company.description: Beyond Meat is a food processing company that specializes in providing plant-based meat. The company aims to make a positive impact on four growing global issues such as human health, climate change, constraints on natural resources, and animal welfare. Its plant-based meats are made by combining expert innovation with simple, non-GMO ingredients. Beyond Meat's products offer greater or equal protein levels than their animal counterparts, no cholesterol, less saturated fat, and no antibiotics or hormones.

aiResearchSummary.text: Beyond Meat is researching meat-like food products, focusing on a meat structured protein product and an agent release system that uses an emulsion with encapsulated binding agents and a specific melting point. This work centers on developing plant-based alternatives that mimic the structure and sensory attributes of traditional meat, highlighting efforts in protein structuring and controlled ingredient release within plant-based foods.
